sector_question: Track diagnosis, customer-device custody, consent, parts, repair tests and return acceptance.
context_questions: What problem and measurable operating outcome matter?
Which users, sites, branches and field locations are involved?
Which data is sensitive and who owns it?
What downtime and data loss can the owner tolerate?
What budget, staff capacity and support reach are actually available?
Which current legal, regulatory, procurement and contract instruments apply?
What existing systems, versions and migration constraints must be respected?

requirements.title: Business workflow
requirements.requirement: Map the work from enquiry or input through delivery, payment and support.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Observe one complete work cycle and identify users, handoffs, exceptions and delays.
requirements.deliverable: Workflow map, problem baseline and accountable owner.
requirements.acceptance: The owner and actual operator can trace a normal case and an exception.

requirements.title: Budget and lifecycle cost
requirements.requirement: Establish an affordable acquisition, operating and replacement plan.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Obtain dated quotations and explicit assumptions for installation, subscriptions, support, power and renewal.
requirements.deliverable: Comparable lifecycle cost scenarios and spending authority.
requirements.acceptance: Every cost has a unit, period, basis and owner; unknown costs remain visible.

requirements.title: Identity and access
requirements.requirement: Give each person the access their work requires and remove it when roles change.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Inventory users, shared logins, sensitive actions and joiner/leaver procedures.
requirements.acceptance: A test user can perform assigned work and cannot perform prohibited work; access removal is demonstrated.

requirements.title: Backup and recovery
requirements.requirement: Recover essential records and systems after loss or failure.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Identify essential data, tolerable loss, recovery time and available storage/connectivity.
requirements.deliverable: Backup ownership, retention and restore plan.
requirements.acceptance: Restore a representative backup in an isolated environment and compare it to the agreed recovery target.

evidence.finding: The selected test record was absent after restore. This is invented test data, not an actual shop incident.

requirements.rationale: Synthetic exercise: the selected backup could not restore the selected test record.
requirements.next_action: Investigate the failed restore, correct the backup process, and repeat a controlled restore test.

requirements.title: Power and connectivity
requirements.requirement: Match equipment and service operation to actual site conditions.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Measure power/load conditions with competent staff; record link availability and required operating hours.
requirements.deliverable: Site readiness and outage response plan.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate agreed power/link failure behaviour safely before acceptance.

requirements.title: Records and financial integration
requirements.requirement: Keep transaction, stock and service records consistent with actual operations.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Inspect current record formats, reconciliation steps, access and software interfaces.
requirements.deliverable: Record model, reconciliation checklist and integration requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile a representative test transaction across affected records without unexplained differences.

requirements.title: Training and adoption
requirements.requirement: Make the solution usable by the people who operate it.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Observe language, accessibility, task familiarity, staff turnover and available learning time.
requirements.acceptance: Representative users complete agreed tasks and an exception without the installer doing the work.

requirements.title: Support and asset lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Define who maintains, repairs, renews and replaces each component.
requirements.evidence_to_collect: Check local service reach, included warranty terms, spare parts, subscriptions and response responsibilities.
requirements.deliverable: Asset register, support handover and renewal calendar.
requirements.acceptance: A realistic support request reaches the accountable person and the escalation route works.

required_outputs: Evidence gaps and authorized next decisions
limitations: Scale labels describe workflow complexity; they are not Nepal statutory enterprise-size definitions.
A selected profile creates an assessment plan, not proof that requirements are met.
Critical or sensitive operations need deeper review even in a one-person organization.
Technology/operating needs are covered; sector-specific professional conclusions require appropriate expertise.

context.locality: Synthetic Nepal locality; not an official-code match
